run_demo_pretrained: run the demo script to load a PhysicsLM4 pretrained model from HuggingFace and generate text
load_model_from_huggingface: load a pretrained PhysicsLM4 model from HuggingFace using AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained
load_tokenizer_from_huggingface: load a tokenizer for a PhysicsLM4 model using AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained
generate_text_with_model: generate text by calling model.generate with tokenized input IDs and max_new_tokens
decode_token_ids: decode generated token IDs back to text using tokenizer.decode with skip_special_tokens
